lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Bi8F16 (reduced formula LiBi2F4) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 28 atoms in the unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi and Li centers each with eight fluorine neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while F centers show two distinct environments: one with one Bi and two Li neighbors and another with four Bi neighbors, with Bi–F distances of 2.2877 Å and F–F distances of 2.3864 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between F-centered 4-vertex and 6-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Bi- and Li-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
